header: Job openings as rows, one link each
lead: Each row shows the job title, location, contract type and a link. The whole row is clickable, so it is easy to tap on a phone.
note: Use the note for readers who want to apply although no opening matches.

roles.title: The job title labels the row
roles.description: and the description holds location and contract type

roles.title: Lines between rows
roles.description: so the rows read as one list, not as separate cards

roles.title: A row without a link
roles.description: shows as plain text, because a broken link is worse than none
